about: Next-cycle OFFICIAL exam calendars (researched 27 Sep 2026). Every entry is a date the conducting body itself published, with the document URL on that body's own host and the exact table cell / line it came from. Read by scripts/import-annual-calendars.ts, which re-downloads every source and re-checks every entry's evidence before anything is written. Dates are Asia/Kolkata calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing here is an estimate: a month-only schedule (SSC 2026-27, IBPS RRB notification) is left out, and so is anything an official source could not be fetched for (see notIncluded).
reviewFixes: 27 Sep 2026 (verify pass): TN_TNPSC_GROUP4 NOTIFICATION 2026-10-06 — removed '2327 vacancies' from notes and quote. On tnpsc.gov.in/english/annual_planner.html that number sits only inside an HTML comment () under a commented-out 'No. of Vacancies' header; the live planner says 'The vacancies will be announced in the notification.' (now checked as evidence).

27 Sep 2026 (verify pass): BR_BPSC_CCE EXAM 2026-10-25 — removed '1189 vacancies' from notes and quote. The calendar (14-08-2026) still shows 1189, but BPSC's corrigendum of 03.09.2026 (bpsc.bihar.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/BPSC_content/Notices/Corrigendum-72nd-CCE-Reduction-of-2-posts-of-BPS_BPSC-20260903-23e57k.pdf) puts the total at 1187; the date 25-10-2026 is unchanged on the re-fetched calendar.

27 Sep 2026 (verify pass): RJ_RPSC_RAS labels and notes now say the dates are proposed — the RPSC press note of 02.07.2026 reads 'करवाया जाना प्रस्तावित है' (re-read from the page image; sha256 unchanged).

sources.title: Programme of Examinations/Recruitment Tests (RTs) - 2027
sources.readingNote: Ruled table with merged cells: NDA & NA (I) / CDS (I) share one set of date cells (rows 7-8), as do CS(P) / IFS(P) (rows 9-10) and NDA & NA (II) / CDS (II) (rows 20-21). pdftotext -layout misplaces these rows, so every date is checked against pdfplumber's reading of the ruled grid (a merged cell's text repeated over the rows it covers). Footnote: 'The dates of notification, commencement and duration of Examinations/ RTs are liable to alteration, if the circumstances so warrant.'

sources.title: Public Notice 16 September 2026: Publication of the Examination Calendar of the National Testing Agency (NTA) up to March 2027 - reg.
sources.readingNote: Scanned image PDF (no text layer): the table was read from the page image on 27 Sep 2026 and the file is pinned by its SHA-256, so a changed calendar is refused rather than trusted. The same table is at https://nta.ac.in/Download/Notice/Examcalendar.pdf. The notice says the dates 'are tentative and may undergo changes' and that the calendar 'does not constitute a notification for any particular examination'.

sources.title: GATE 2027 — Important Dates
sources.readingNote: Superseded dates are shown struck through (<del>) on the page — 14 Aug / 27 Aug portal opening, 21 Sep and 30 Sep closings. Struck text is removed before any check, so only the live dates can match. Page footer: '*All dates are liable to change'. The GATE 2027 Information Brochure (https://gate2027ib.iitm.ac.in/GATE2027-IB.pdf, p.5) adds: 'Exact details of the complete examination schedule will be notified later on the GATE 2027 website.'

The planner's Group I (06.09.2026) and Group II (25.10.2026) exam dates were overtaken by the published notifications (Group I prelims on 27.09.2026 and Group II prelims are on the tracker from the TNPSC notices), so they are not imported. sources.title: UPPSC Exam Calendar 2026 — विज्ञप्ति दिनांक 30 जनवरी, 2026 (संख्या: 2920/14/मिस/ई-1/2000-01 टी.सी.)
sources.readingNote: Linked as 'UPPSC Exam Calendar 2026' on the UPPSC home page. The link only serves the PDF inside a session opened on the home page (a bare request is redirected to the home page), and the server appends its HTML page after the PDF's %%EOF; the hash covers the PDF bytes up to %%EOF. The Hindi text uses a legacy font whose text layer is not Unicode, so the row was read from the page image; the dates in the text layer are checked as well. Note 2 on p.4: 'उपर्युक्त तिथियां सम्भावित हैं।' (the above dates are tentative).
